lines.title: This is pi-context-refs. Save the context you keep retyping, and send it with a hash.
lines.save: First, save a file as a ref. One command gives it a name and a short description.
lines.picker: Now type the hash. A list of your refs opens, and a mark shows which library each one comes from. We pick api.
lines.placeholder: The editor holds a short placeholder. One backspace deletes all of it, so a ref is never half deleted. We pick it again.
lines.sent: When the message is sent, the model gets the current text of the file. The transcript shows one line for it, with the kind and the size.
lines.builtin: Four git refs need no setup. Review hash diff sends the changes you have not committed yet.
lines.overlay: Alt and r opens an overlay with a preview of exactly what a ref will send.
lines.sent-command: And slash ref sent shows the full text of the last message.
lines.end: To install it, run the command on screen. Then save your first ref.
